FFmpeg Windows Minimal Build Profile
====================================

This directory is intended to hold a generated minimal FFmpeg SDK used by
`speech_utils` Windows native bindings.

Preferred CI build path:
- Trigger `.github/workflows/build_windows_ffmpeg_lib.yml`
- Default FFmpeg ref: `n7.1.1` (override via workflow input)

The SDK is auto-built by the build hook when:
- `SPEECH_UTILS_WINDOWS_FFMPEG_AUTOBUILD=1`
- FFmpeg source is available (default path
  `third_party/ffmpeg/source/ffmpeg`, or override with
  `SPEECH_UTILS_WINDOWS_FFMPEG_SOURCE_DIR`)

Build profile configured in `hook/src/windows_ffmpeg_pipeline.dart`:
- `--disable-everything`
- `--disable-programs`
- `--disable-doc`
- `--disable-network`
- `--enable-shared`
- `--disable-static`
- `--enable-small`
- `--enable-avcodec`
- `--enable-avformat`
- `--enable-avutil`
- `--enable-swresample`
- `--enable-encoder=aac`
- `--enable-decoder=pcm_s16le,aac,mp3`
- `--enable-parser=aac,mpegaudio`
- `--enable-demuxer=wav,mov,mp3,aac`
- `--enable-muxer=ipod,adts`
- `--enable-protocol=file`

Resulting artifacts expected by the hook:
- `include/libavcodec`
- `include/libavformat`
- `include/libavutil`
- `include/libswresample`
- `lib/avcodec.lib`
- `lib/avformat.lib`
- `lib/avutil.lib`
- `lib/swresample.lib`
- `bin/avcodec-*.dll`
- `bin/avformat-*.dll`
- `bin/avutil-*.dll`
- `bin/swresample-*.dll`
